narrative.district.business.arrival: The Ledger Spine is laundering more than money. Break the first sealed annex and look behind the facade.
narrative.district.entertainment.arrival: The Afterglow is broadcasting a carrier signal. Kill the stage lights; keep the memory intact.
narrative.district.military.arrival: The Iron Corridor is shipping living siege engines. Their manifest ends at the Crownward.
narrative.district.residential.arrival: Ashwater records show whole families erased from census rolls. Find out where they went.
narrative.district.royal.arrival: Royal continuity signatures match your own chassis. This is where they kept the previous pilots.
narrative.dossier.business_crown_reserve: The 04:17 neural maps were purchased, classified, and shipped east through refrigerated transfer lines.
LEDGER corroboration was optional; destruction never closed the district route, and an elite command memory can restore the lost packet.
The archive cassette was lost. The route stayed open; LEDGER remains recoverable from a later elite.
The upper archive cassette survived; LEDGER corroboration was preserved.
